status: closed mechanism negative on both local cards
scope: Mechanism-only real-shape microbenchmark; these timings are not endpoint or model throughput claims.
method: Eight paired warmups; six alternating blocks of twenty samples per arm; eight invocations per sample; explicit queue wait; per-invocation wall time.
decision: The preregistered 5% threshold failed on both cards. Reusing pointer-independent oneDNN primitive objects was neutral on GPU0 and slower on GPU1, consistent with oneDNN's internal primitive cache already absorbing construction cost. Do not implement an endpoint primitive cache.
next_target: Optimize the dominant gate/up GEMM data path or its consumer rather than wrapper object construction.
